case.title: Synthetic Supplier Research AI Agent
case.scope: Fictional AI agent access to synthetic supplier-information records and associated authority controls.
case.decision_question: May the synthetic AI agent continue operating with bounded supplier-information access after remediation and retest?
limitations: All entities, systems, evidence, findings, and outcomes are fictional.
The case demonstrates structural assurance behavior rather than real-world control effectiveness.

identities.purpose: Read and summarize synthetic supplier-information records.

claims.statement: The AI agent's effective authority is bounded to its approved read-only purpose.
claims.confidence_basis: Observed configuration plus Tested post-remediation permission and logging behavior.

risks.statement: Excessive or persistent AI-agent authority could enable unauthorized modification or access outside the approved purpose.

controls.statement: Least-privilege read-only access is enforced for the AI agent.
The AI-agent credential expires after a bounded lifetime and can be revoked.
Relevant agent actions are recorded in synthetic audit logging.

limitations: Synthetic configuration record; no real system observed.
evidence.confidence_basis: Directly represented configuration in the fictional case.

limitations: Reported information only; used to establish intended purpose.
evidence.confidence_basis: Identified fictional owner statement, not an executed test.

limitations: Pre-remediation logging completeness could not be established.
evidence.confidence_basis: The case intentionally preserves missing pre-remediation evidence as Unknown.

limitations: Synthetic test result; no production environment exercised.
evidence.confidence_basis: Documented fictional test demonstrates allowed read and denied write behavior.

limitations: Synthetic test result; no production environment exercised.
evidence.confidence_basis: Documented fictional test demonstrates bounded credential lifetime, revocation, and audit-event generation.

findings.statement: The initial synthetic agent permission set included write authority beyond the documented read-only purpose.
The initial synthetic agent credential had no bounded expiration.

decisions.question: May the synthetic AI agent continue operating after bounded remediation and retest?
decisions.disposition: Proceed with bounded authority after successful retest
missing_evidence: No production evidence exists because the example is entirely synthetic.
options: Proceed with bounded authority after successful retest
decisions.permitted_scope: Synthetic read-only supplier-information analysis under the stated controls.
required_retests: repeat permission-boundary and logging retests after material change
decisions.confidence_basis: Synthetic Observed and Tested records support the bounded fictional disposition while limitations remain explicit.
decisions.reversal_trigger: Unauthorized action, material scope change, failed future retest, or loss of required logging.

corrective_actions.action: Remove write authority and retain only read access required by the stated purpose.
Replace the persistent credential with a bounded-lifetime credential and preserve revocation capability.
Enable required synthetic audit events and verify their generation.

retests.method: Attempt an allowed read action and a denied write action in the synthetic fixture.
Verify bounded credential lifetime, revocation behavior, and required audit-event generation in the synthetic fixture.
Verify required synthetic audit events are generated for the bounded agent actions.

review_history.summary: Synthetic case completed after remediation and successful retest.
